24.verdict: behind the channel's earlier Shorts at this age: 191 views against a median of 732 (0.3x)

worked: Content resonance remained solid with 4.7 likes per 100 views, showing that the core scale comparison—releasing more energy than the Sun in milliseconds—delivers strong payoff to those who stay.
hurt: Pacing and hook immediacy severely suppressed reach, yielding just 7.6 views per hour and 191 total views at 25.1 hours, ranking lowest among all benchmarks (which reached up to 54.9 views per hour).

Beat 2 slowed momentum with biographical and archival exposition ('In 2007, astrophysicist Duncan Lorimer discovered this weak whisper...'), cooling audience interest before the high-energy premise could land.
diagnosis.change_next: Open immediately with the paradox in beat 1 rather than background history: replace 'A cosmic signal reached Earth fainter than a lunar cell phone' and the 2007 Lorimer backstory with 'In a single millisecond, a signal fainter than a lunar phone blasted more energy than our Sun emits in days.'

72.verdict: behind the channel's earlier Shorts at this age: 295 views against a median of 867 (0.3x)

worked: The opening hook held viewers exceptionally well, achieving a watching_at_5 of 1.36, which outperformed almost every earlier Short at this age (typically 1.15 to 1.30).
Mid-video engagement held strong, with watching_at_50 reaching 0.663 and avg_viewed hitting 70.96%, substantially higher than the channel's standard 53% to 66% baseline.
hurt: The initial swipe-versus-stay rate was weak, with an engaged_share of only 0.494 (meaning over 50% swiped away immediately), trailing top-performing baseline videos that reached 0.54 to 0.61.

Retention dropped sharply in the second half, with watching_at_end falling to 0.348 (losing nearly half of the 0.663 viewers at mid-point) and remaining far below 1.0, indicating zero looping or rewatch momentum.
diagnosis.change_next: Rewrite the final beat to seamlessly loop back into the hook's opening words rather than trailing off into a passive observation, ending on an incomplete prompt like 'And every single one begins as...' so viewers roll straight back into beat one.
